title: Replacement Relief Amount — FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit
content:
**Clause — FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit.** The replacement relief is the returned-payment fee booked against the line's most recent returned payment (the latest return by return date; of two returns on the same date, the one recorded first), waived in full; with no returned-payment fee booked against that return, or no payment recorded against it as its replacement, there is no relief. The relief is rounded to the cent; every rounding to the cent here takes an exact half cent to the even cent.

*Replacement payment* means a payment entry on the line recorded against that return. *The fee* is the returned-payment fee entry tied to that return.

## Cases (hypothetical ledgers)

| Most recent return | Fee booked against it | Replacement recorded against it | Relief |
|---|---|---|---|
| 300.00 returned 2 March | 15.00 | 300.00 on 4 March | 15.00 USD |
| 300.00 returned 2 March | 12.60 | 150.00 on 4 March | 12.60 USD |
| 300.00 returned 2 March | none | 300.00 on 4 March | no relief |
| 300.00 returned 2 March | 15.00 | none | no relief |
